ja: 学生のころピアノを続けとけばよかったなあ。
en: I wish I'd kept playing piano as a student.
alternatives: If only I'd stuck with the piano back then.
I wish I hadn't quit piano as a student.
point: 過去の後悔は wish + had 過去分詞

ja: ギターはもうやめたの？昔はバンドにいた？
en: Have you quit guitar? Were you in a band?
alternatives: You've given up guitar? Were you in a band?
Did you quit guitar? Were you in a band?
point: 「昔は」は過去形 were。「もうやめた」は現在完了が自然

ja: 失礼ですが、休日はどう過ごされているんですか？
en: Might I ask how you spend your days off?
alternatives: May I ask how you usually spend your days off?
Do you mind if I ask how you spend weekends?
point: how 以下は疑問文の語順にせず how you spend

ja: 妹はインドア派なのに、週末はサーフィンだよ。
en: Although she's indoorsy, my sister surfs on weekends.
alternatives: My sister surfs on weekends despite being indoorsy.
My sister's indoorsy, but she surfs on weekends.
point: go surfing は to を付けない。although と but は併用しない

ja: 私がしたいのは、家にいることだけ。
en: What I want is to stay home.
alternatives: All I want to do is stay home.
I just want to stay home.
point: 「〜したいこと」は What I want を主語にする

ja: 先週の大会で誰が優勝したか、まだ見てないんだ。
en: I haven't checked who won last week's tournament yet.
alternatives: I still haven't looked up who won last week's tournament.
I haven't seen who won the tournament last week yet.
point: 「誰が優勝したか」は who won と肯定文の語順で続ける

ja: 姉は毎週日曜、ヨガをしています。
en: My sister does yoga every Sunday.
alternatives: My sister practices yoga every Sunday.
Every Sunday, my sister does yoga.
point: 習慣は現在形、主語が三人称単数なので does

ja: 電話をくれた時、庭仕事をしてたよ。
en: I was gardening when you called.
alternatives: When you called, I was gardening.
I was in the garden when you called.
point: 途中だった動作は過去進行形、割り込んだ出来事は過去形

ja: 父はピアノが弾けません。
en: My father can't play the piano.
alternatives: My dad can't play the piano.
My dad can't play piano.
point: can't の後ろは原形の play。楽器には the を付ける

ja: 弟さんが話してたゲーム、あのカフェに置いてるか知ってる？
en: Do you know if they carry the game he mentioned?
alternatives: Do you know whether that café has the game he mentioned?
Any idea if they have the game he mentioned?
point: 「〜かどうか」は if/whether で、後ろは平叙文の語順

ja: 新しいボルダリングジム、もう行ってみた？
en: Have you tried the new bouldering gym yet?
alternatives: Have you been to the new bouldering gym yet?
Have you checked out the new bouldering gym?
point: 「もう〜した？」は現在完了の疑問文＋ yet

ja: この近くにテニスコートはある？
en: Is there a tennis court nearby?
alternatives: Is there a tennis court near here?
Are there any tennis courts nearby?
point: 疑問文は Is there で始める。There is の語順のままにしない

ja: ここ、漫画がたくさんあるよ。
en: There are lots of manga here.
alternatives: This place has lots of manga.
There's a lot of manga here.
point: 「たくさんある」は There are lots of で言う

ja: 山なら水を多めに持ってったほうがいいよ。
en: In the mountains, you should bring extra water.
alternatives: You should take plenty of water up there.
Bring extra water if you go hiking.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は should で表す

ja: 早く出ていれば、場所取りできたのにね。
en: If we'd left earlier, we'd have gotten a spot.
alternatives: We could have gotten a spot if we'd left earlier.
If only we'd left earlier, we'd have gotten a spot.
point: 過去の仮定は had+過去分詞、結果は would have+過去分詞

ja: 夫は日曜、ラジオを聞きながら庭いじりしてます。
en: My husband gardens on Sundays, listening to the radio.
alternatives: My husband spends Sundays gardening and listening to the radio.
On Sundays, my husband gardens with the radio on.
point: 「〜しながら」は文の後ろに -ing 形をつなげて表せる

ja: 兄はキャンプ道具を磨くだけで、めったに使わない。
en: My brother polishes his gear but rarely uses it.
alternatives: My brother polishes his camping gear but seldom uses it.
My brother polishes his gear but hardly ever uses it.
point: gear は数えられない名詞なので gears としない

ja: 兄は釣り大会で夜明け前から並んだに違いない。
en: My brother must have lined up before dawn.
alternatives: My brother must have gotten in line before dawn.
My brother must have been in line before dawn.
point: 過去の強い推量は must have + 過去分詞で表す

ja: ケンは今週末に小説を書くって言ってたけど、どうだか。
en: Ken said he'd write a novel this weekend. Yeah, right.
alternatives: Ken said he'd write a novel this weekend. I doubt it.
Ken told me he'd write a novel this weekend. We'll see.
point: 「言ってた」に合わせて内容の will を would にずらす

ja: ギターって、いつから習ってるの？
en: How long have you been learning the guitar?
alternatives: How long have you been taking guitar lessons?
When did you start learning the guitar?
point: 今も続いている期間は How long have you been 〜ing

ja: 週末がもっと長かったら、何か趣味を始める？
en: If weekends were longer, would you take up a hobby?
alternatives: Would you pick up a hobby if weekends were longer?
If the weekend were longer, would you start a hobby?
point: 現実と違う仮定は if 節を過去形 were、主節は would に

ja: うちは結婚以来、同じ場所でキャンプしてるよ。
en: We've camped at the same place since marrying.
alternatives: We've gone to the same campsite since our wedding.
We've been camping at the same place since marrying.
point: since があるので現在形ではなく現在完了にする

ja: 母は最近、水彩画にすっかりはまっているんです。
en: My mom has really gotten into watercolor painting lately.
alternatives: My mother's totally hooked on watercolors these days.
My mom's really into watercolors lately.
point: 「はまる」は get into。今の状態は現在完了で言う

ja: 週末は何してるの？
en: What do you do on weekends?
alternatives: What do you usually do on weekends?
How do you spend your weekends?
point: 習慣を聞くので現在形。「週末に」は on weekends

ja: バイクを持って行った店が、もう閉店していたんだよ。
en: The shop where I took my bike had closed.
alternatives: The shop I took my bike to had closed.
The shop I'd taken my bike to had closed down.
point: 行った時点より前の出来事は過去完了 had closed

ja: 日曜、一緒にトランプしよう。
en: Let's play cards on Sunday.
alternatives: Why don't we play cards Sunday?
Let's play a card game Sunday.
point: Let's の後ろは動詞の原形。「日曜に」は on Sunday

ja: 私が癒されるのはヨガじゃなくて、川沿いの散歩なんです。
en: It's riverside walks, not yoga, that help me unwind.
alternatives: What helps me unwind isn't yoga but walks by the river.
It's walking by the river, not yoga, that relaxes me.
Riverside walks, not yoga, are what help me unwind.
point: It's B, not A, that で強調。that の後の動詞は B に合わせる

ja: 姉のボルダリングジム、初心者クラス始めたらしいよ。
en: Apparently my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
alternatives: I hear my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
Looks like my sister's bouldering gym started a beginners' class.
point: 「らしい」は apparently や I hear で伝聞のニュアンスを出す

ja: 日曜は一日中、映画を観てたよ。
en: I watched movies all day Sunday.
alternatives: I watched movies all day last Sunday.
I spent all day Sunday watching movies.
point: 「一日中」は all day。the や a をつけない
